title: Esther 5:1 — on the third day Esther stands before the king (16 Nisan)
summary: Esther 5:1: on the third day Esther puts on her royal robes and stands in the palace's inner court facing the king on his throne. The slide dates this as 16 Nisan and highlights "third day".

text.text: 1 On the third day Esther put on her royal robes and stood in the inner court of the palace, in front of the king’s hall. The king was sitting on his royal throne in the hall, facing the entrance.

numbers.note: 16 Nisan — the third day, when Esther goes before the king
